name: Christmas Celebration With Sakuya Izayoi
source:
The Hakurei Shrine Maiden had this brilliant idea to host a Christmas themed festival in the human village, and it immediately caught on! All of the residents of Gensokyo, human or youkai are invited to celebrate Christmas and have fun in any way they can! You're out on a date with Sakuya and you're there to have fun with her as you explore the various sights and attractions going around in the festival! 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835060/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
博丽神社少女想出了一个绝妙的主意，要在人类村落里举办一场以圣诞节为主题的祭典，并且立刻就流行起来了！幻想乡的所有居民，无论是人类还是妖怪，都被邀请来庆祝圣诞节，并以各种方式享受乐趣！你正在与Sakuya约会，你可以在探索节日期间的各种景点和景点的同时与她一起享受乐趣！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835060/]Steam[/url]]
